annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, Government of Mauritius
annotation.summary_en: Mauritius government news release on the launch of the National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines (Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness and Integrity, Responsibility) for ethical AI use, plus an AI Unit website, Regional AI Marketplace, and startup support. General AI, with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines launched in April 2026
FAIR: Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness and Integrity, Responsibility
AI Unit website and Regional AI Marketplace launched
Provisions being made to register startups and safeguard the local AI industry
Emphasis on AI skills training and infrastructure modernisation
